title: Explaining Heterogeneous Treatment Effects with Causal Forests and the Hoeffding Functional Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.16447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects is a central objective of causal inference. However, state-of-the-art algorithms to solve this task are based on machine learning principles, and thus behave as black boxes. Consequently, the identification of covariates driving heterogeneity remains a challenging and open problem. To address this limitation, we introduce CausalTreeHFD, an interpretable extension of causal forests, based on the Hoeffding functional decomposition adapted to tree ensembles. Our approach decomposes predictions of conditional average treatment effects (CATE) into contributions from individual covariates and pairwise interactions, providing a direct characterization of the factors driving treatment effect heterogeneity. We establish the consistency of CausalTreeHFD, which converges towards the Hoeffding decomposition of the underlying CATE function, under standard assumptions for the analysis of causal forests

translated_title: 基于因果森林与Hoeffding函数分解解释异质性处理效应
translated_abstract: 异质性处理效应的估计是因果推断的核心目标。然而，目前解决该任务的最先进算法基于机器学习原理，因此表现为黑箱。 consequently，识别驱动异质性的协变量仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了CausalTreeHFD，这是一种可解释的因果森林扩展方法，基于适用于树集成模型的Hoeffding函数分解。我们的方法将条件平均处理效应（CATE）的预测分解为单个协变量的贡献和成对交互作用的贡献，从而直接刻画了驱动处理效应异质性的因素。我们在因果森林分析的标准假设下，证明了CausalTreeHFD的一致性，即它收敛于底层CATE函数的Hoeffding分解。
tldr: 本文提出CausalTreeHFD，一种基于Hoeffding函数分解的可解释因果森林扩展方法，能够将CATE预测分解为单个协变量和成对交互作用的贡献，直接揭示驱动处理效应异质性的因素，并证明了该方法收敛于真实CATE函数Hoeffding分解的一致性。
en_tdlr: We propose CausalTreeHFD, an interpretable extension of causal forests based on the Hoeffding functional decomposition, which decomposes CATE predictions into individual covariate and pairwise interaction contributions to directly characterize treatment effect heterogeneity, and we establish its consistency toward the Hoeffding decomposition of the underlying CATE function.
